description: Taylor has race condition in /get-patch that allows purchase token replay
how_introduced: Yes. AI-authored commit 57b7634391959dbbdb39b387ac4dc68157cd58a1 introduced the single-use token logic as a non-atomic SELECT/check/UPDATE sequence in /get-patch, creating the TOCTOU race that the fix replaced with one atomic UPDATE ... AND token_used_at IS NULL. A later human commit (5e5a80b5ffd0b6fccf7bdc2d8793e8b01cb83844) refactored the route but preserved the same vulnerable flow.

agent_verdicts.reasoning: This AI-authored commit first introduced token_used_at, the "Purchase token has already been used." check, and the separate UPDATE purchases SET token_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ? after the earlier SELECT. Pickaxe search shows the token_used_at strings and the update statement originate here. That is exactly the non-atomic check-then-act pattern the fix replaced with a single conditional UPDATE, so this commit introduced the race.
